programs.title: Nazi Megastructures: Battle Ready
programs.desc: Profiles of engineers responsible for the construction of the most dangerous military facilities.Their works contributed to the technological revolution.The figures of Heinrich Himmler and Joseph Goebbels, who were completely devoted to Hitler, will also be introduced.The Führer assigned them the task of building the Nazi social machine.The program will also discuss the attack on the Soviet Union and the failure of total war tactics.You will be able to learn about the creation of the battleships Bismarck and Tirpitz, as well as the bunkers intended to protect submarines.In addition, the creators will talk about the conflict in the Pacific and the largest floating fortress armed with powerful guns.

programs.title: How to Lose a War
programs.desc: The situation in 1941 indicated that the Axis powers would win the war.The conflict began with a series of brilliant victories for the Germans, Italians and Japanese.Hitler managed to conquer almost all of Europe.

programs.title: Border Patrol
programs.desc: The series reports on the everyday life of dedicated New Zealand customs officers, working around the clock at the country's borders.Their tasks include, among others:catching transports of drugs and other illegal items, or intercepting objects containing potentially dangerous diseases.The program's heroes also monitor people arriving in the country to prevent individuals whose presence is not welcome there from entering its territory.Viewers will find out what technology customs officers use and how trained animals support them.

programs.title: Lost Treasures of The Maya
programs.desc: Albert Lin spędził w gwatemalskiej dżungli wiele miesięcy w towarzystwie międzynarodowego zespołu naukowców.Rejestrował materiał w dwunastu głównych stanowiskach archeologicznych.Badacze mieli do dyspozycji urządzenie LiDAR, które działa podobnie jak rentgen.Pozwoliło ono zeskanować z powietrza ukształtowanie terenu.Thanks to this, a digital map was developed.Powstała też specjalna aplikacja pokazująca tamtejszy krajobraz bez zalesienia.Therefore, there was no need to cut down the trees.Natrafiono na obiekty stanowiące część nieznanych wcześniej miast, w tym piramidy oraz ufortyfikowaną cytadelę.They also found the skeleton of the queen, the ruler's burial chamber with richly decorated ritual vessels, fragments of the skull of a sacrificed child, bas-reliefs, a stone altar, a painted vase, as well as dozens of statuettes and ceramic objects.Poczynione odkrycia pozwoliły przewartościować dotychczasową wiedzę o cywilizacji Majów.
